items.title: Scripture devotional app - onboarding set in green, cream and candle-orange
items.description: A collage of eight screens from a Christian devotional app. Recurring cover screens read 'Grow closer to God a little more everyday' on deep green with cream serif type and a small floral mark, above get-started and log-in buttons. Interior screens show a scripture feed ('This is what's possible when the scripture meets real life') built from testimonial cards with avatars and star ratings, plus full-bleed warm variants - a lit candle reading 'Find peace in God's Word' and a walking-figure scene 'Along the Road'. The system alternates calm green covers with warm orange moments, leaning on serif display type and generous whitespace.
items.quality: Collage of small screens; headlines legible, body copy partly soft.

items.title: Should I go outside - two weather verdicts with colour-coded metric chips
items.description: Two bold iPhone mockups for a playful weather-decision app, 'Should I go outside [Now] in [Toronto]'. The left card answers 'No' on a salmon block, the right 'Maybe' on yellow. Under each verdict a grid of colour-coded metric chips - Temp (Cold 5 deg), Wind (High / Some 30 km/h), Rain (Too much / Some 100%), Air Quality (Good) - each a labelled two-line tile in its own saturated hue. A bottom tab bar (Home, Forecast, Activities, Profile) closes each screen. The colour-coding carries the whole hierarchy; the type is heavy and poster-like.

items.title: Rentify - rental home with search, stay chips and a featured studio card
items.description: A rental-app home screen branded 'Rentify'. The header greets 'Goodmorning, Jay' and states 'Find your next home' beside an avatar and bell. Below sit a filter chip row (All, Apartments, Houses) and a search field, a promo banner ('Get 60% Off Your Stay'), then a featured listing card - 'Mid-Century Arched Studio', star rating, beds/bedrooms chips and '$145 / night' - fronted by a photograph of a brick apartment building. The photo-forward listing card is the screen's anchor; the rest is wayfinding.

items.title: Blue commerce home - greeting, search, service chips and trending products
items.description: A saturated-blue shopping/delivery app home. The header reads 'Goodafternoon Alex, Welcome back' with an avatar, above a prominent search bar ('What do you need today?') and a slim alert banner. A row of service chips (Shopping, Delivery, Food) sits over a white promo card 'Everything you need in one place' with a courier illustration, then a 'Trending' product grid (Nike shoe $130.00, Black Zip Jacket $150.00) with heart affordances, closing on a bottom tab bar. The blue field with floating white cards gives strong figure-ground contrast.

items.title: Dashr splash - one wordmark on a single green field
items.description: A bright lime-green phone screen with nothing but the wordmark 'Dashr' centred in dark type, plus the standard status bar and home indicator. A pure splash/brand moment: the whole screen reserved for one word, no imagery, no button. The single-colour field is the design.

items.title: Product-detail reviews sheet - avatar rows with star ratings
items.description: A phone mockup presenting a 'Product Details' bottom sheet scrolled to 'Reviews (124)'. A vertical list of review rows, each with a circular photographic avatar, a reviewer name (Osagwuero Osifo, Ordora Osafor, Chinedu Ita, Benjamin Preae, Matthew Iyanu, Abdul Abdulkareem, Temitope Adeyemi), a five-star rating row and a one-line comment, closes with a 'connected to your product' footnote and a floating camera button. Annotated 'DESIGNED BY Fuego.UI'. The pattern is a scannable social-proof list.

items.title: Reviews empty state - line-art open box and 'No review yet'
items.description: A 'Product Details' bottom sheet showing 'Reviews (0)' with a centred line-art illustration of an open box with small spark lines, drawn in thin grey stroke on white, above the headline 'No review yet' and the sub-line 'This product doesn't have any review yet.'. Captioned 'Empty State', annotated 'DESIGNED BY Fuego.UI'. A textbook empty state: one illustration, two lines, nothing else.

items.title: Chat inbox - message rows with avatars, previews and timestamps
items.description: A 'Chat' screen headed by a search field ('Search names, groups...') and a compose button. A 'Messages / Requests (+3)' section lists conversation rows - Family Group, Jane Adams, Michael Carter, Sophia Miller, Jake Anderson, Ronny Sanders, Manny Ansel - each with a round avatar, a one-line preview ('You comin to gym today or nah??', 'I am sooo bored bro lets go get su...') and a right-aligned timestamp (2m to 2d). A floating bottom nav bar with a highlighted chat tab closes the view. A standard messenger inbox.

items.title: Habit home - week strip, 'Make today count' card and daily routine list
items.description: A habit-tracker home greeting 'Hello Joana, Welcome back' beside an avatar and bell. A horizontal week strip (Mon-Sun with dates, today marked) sits above a pale-blue 'Make today count' card urging 'Add a habit to your routine' with an 'Add New habit' button. The 'Daily routine / See all' list follows - Meditate to Relax, Drink Water, Go for a Walk, Read a Book - each row with a pastel icon tile, a streak line and a duration, closing on a bottom nav with a black '+' FAB. The pastel icons and streak metadata give the routine its rhythm.

items.title: Habit progress insights - completion figure, week bars and breakdown
items.description: A habit-tracker analytics screen, 'Your progress insights' with a 'This week' selector. It leads with 'Your Average Completion 55%' and a date range, then a fat-bar week chart (Sat-Fri) with one bar highlighted in pale blue under a '0%' badge. Two stat tiles ('20 Completed', '4 Streak') sit above a 'Habit Breakdown' card (Drink Water, 3 streak today) reporting success rate / completion / skipped, closing on a dark 'Share Progress' button. A concise progress dashboard built from one headline number, one chart and a breakdown.

items.title: My Health Plan - timed routine list over a dark tab bar with orange FAB
items.description: A health-routine screen titled 'My Health Plan' with a week strip (Sat 25 - Sun 31, Tue 28 selected) and 'Today Task / Completed: 02/12'. Stacked time-stamped task cards run down the view - Morning Mobility, Hydration Reset, Breathwork Session, Mindfulness Meditation - each with a leading pastel icon, a short description, a time (08:00-06:20) and a status chip (Start / Skip / Finish). A black bottom bar with a central orange FAB closes the screen. Cards group by activity with time as the left rail.

items.title: Courier payout home - pickup banner, tonight's payout and ready list
items.description: A delivery-earnings home for 'Shuto & Co.' with a dark-green hero card - 'Sohel picks up 3:10-3:30 pm, 7 parcels ready at your door' - overlaid with a thin line chart. Beneath, two tiles: a lime 'Tonight's payout ৳12,101 if all 7 are delivered' and an orange 'Needs you: 1 buyer hasn't confirmed'. A 'Ready for pickup' list (Tahmina Akter ৳1,850, Sadia Afrin ৳1,450) shows Confirmed chips, area addresses and times. The bottom nav (Home, Deliveries, +, Money, Account) marks Home active. Amounts are in Bangladeshi taka; the screen is a courier's live earnings dashboard.
